# Osmell Caicedo (oele.dev)

> Senior Laravel engineer based in Bogotá, Colombia, working remote. 10+ years on the Laravel stack (TALL and VILT). Main work is Livewire decomposition, Inertia/Vue migrations and modernizing legacy Laravel apps without changing how they behave. Available for remote contracts and performance audits.

The site is a single page in English at https://oele.dev and in Spanish at https://oele.dev/es. Contact: hola@oele.dev.

## Experience

- Level60 Consulting, Nashville TN (2024 to now), Senior Software Engineer. Several Laravel apps deploy from one codebase against a shared database. I split oversized Livewire components into prop-driven ones and moved business logic out of the views. I merged a React SPA and a separate Laravel API into one Inertia monolith, using Spatie laravel-data DTOs to keep PHP and TypeScript types in sync. I upgraded a production app from Laravel 8 to 12 with Rector, adding test coverage before each step. The heaviest SQL Server queries went from 5 s to 900 ms with targeted queries, Redis and Octane.
- EyeUniversal LLC, San José CA (2022 to 2024), Senior Software Engineer (contract). Lead developer on Run Layout Tool, a drainage configurator built from scratch on Laravel, Inertia and Vue 3. It is still in production. Also shipped Laravel apps and WooCommerce, WordPress and Shopify stores for US clients.
- SENA, Colombia (2021 to 2025), Software Development Instructor. Taught HTML, CSS, JS, PHP/Laravel, Git and CI/CD.
- Ovy.so, Colombia (2017 to 2022), Lead Developer. Migrated a vanilla PHP product to Laravel and Blade, then to Inertia (v1 to v2), and moved the frontend from Vue 2 to Vue 3. Built the Google Workspace integration (Meet, Calendar, Accounts).

## Projects

- [Run Layout Tool](https://runlayouttool.com): VILT app where contractors design rainwater gutter runs. It picks the parts that fit a given length and depth and draws the run as an interactive diagram.
- [laravel-missing-index](https://github.com/oele-dev/laravel-missing-index): Laravel package that runs EXPLAIN on every query in development, flags full table scans and prints the CREATE INDEX statement that fixes them.
- [mkdn](https://github.com/oele-dev/mkdn): Node.js CLI and library, published on npm, that converts PDF, DOCX, Excel, HTML and images to Markdown via Cloudflare Workers AI.
- [vilt-test](https://github.com/oele-dev/vilt-test): MIT starter kit for Vue, Inertia, Laravel and Tailwind with Vite and PHPUnit configured.
- [Malta Pharmacy](https://malta-pharmacy.com): Programmatic SEO directory with 800+ static pages generated at build time from SQLite. No database at runtime.
- [Google Workspace to Laravel integration](https://ovy.co): PHP package connecting Meet, Classroom, Calendar and Accounts to Laravel. Runs virtual classrooms in production.
- QuickBooks and Hotmart billing automation (private): Hotmart webhooks go to queued jobs on Redis, monitored with Horizon. Jobs are idempotent and safe to retry, so each purchase is invoiced once.

## Stack

Laravel, Livewire, Inertia.js, Vue 3, Filament, Tailwind CSS, Redis, Horizon, Octane, MySQL, SQL Server, Next.js, Astro, Docker, CI/CD.
